claim: Patchline ships a provable sampling bound certifying corpus estimates are within a stated error with given confidence. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the provable sampling bound claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make corpus-sampling-theory-gate`.
